name: @imswarnil/swarnil-design
description: Swarnil Design System — a token-first, dependency-free CSS design system for people who make things: web, and the broadcast layer for thumbnails, scenes and streams. Almost monochrome, so one colour can mean something.

scripts.css: npm run css:web && npm run css:broadcast && npm run css:framework && npm run css:bulma
scripts.css:web: postcss src/index.css -o dist/swarnil-design.css && postcss src/index.css -o dist/swarnil-design.min.css --env production
scripts.css:broadcast: postcss src/broadcast.css -o dist/swarnil-broadcast.css && postcss src/broadcast.css -o dist/swarnil-broadcast.min.css --env production
scripts.css:framework: postcss src/framework.css -o dist/swarnil-framework.css && postcss src/framework.css -o dist/swarnil-framework.min.css --env production
scripts.build: npm run css && npm run docs && npm run css:site
scripts.dev: SDS_DEV=1 npm run docs && npm run serve
scripts.size: for f in site/assets/site.min.css dist/swarnil-design.min.css dist/swarnil-design-bulma.min.css dist/swarnil-broadcast.min.css dist/swarnil-framework.min.css; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; printf '%-42s' $f; gzip -c $f | wc -c | awk '{printf "gzipped: %.1f KB\n", $1/1024}'; done
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run audit && npm run size
scripts.css:bulma: sass --load-path=node_modules --no-source-map --quiet src/bulma-theme.scss dist/bulma-base.css && postcss src/bulma.css -o dist/swarnil-design-bulma.css && postcss src/bulma.css -o dist/swarnil-design-bulma.min.css --env production
